# get_text_composition_styles()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.get_text_composition_styles`

## Signature

```python
async def get_text_composition_styles() -> List['types.TextCompositionStyle']: ...
```

## Documentation

Get the text composition styles of the current user: the default styles provided by Telegram and
the custom styles added by the user.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Returns

List of [`TextCompositionStyle`](../../types/messages_and_media/TextCompositionStyle.md): On success, the list of styles is returned.

### Example

```python
styles = await app.get_text_composition_styles()

for style in styles:
    print(style.name, style.title)
```
